verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app builder, so starting from a template or community project is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents a template gallery, starter projects, or a way to remix community projects. The only nearby item mentions making a project public or sending it to another account, which is a sharing feature and does not show founders starting from a template.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a template or community project instead of a blank prompt
